lines: Madras High Court issued the Presidency Small Cause Courts (Adjudication of Penalties and Appeals) Rules, 2026, notified on 30 September 2026.
These rules cover how penalties are decided and appeals handled in the Presidency Small Cause Courts.
The full rule text was not extracted this week, so specific fee or procedure details are not available here.
This week's ordinary gazette mainly lists individuals' name changes in both Tamil and English, plus advertisements by private persons and institutions.
It also carries company-law notifications of company name changes.
No fees, appointments, land, temple, election, exam or government scheme items appear this week.
